text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up: visitor arriving at 3:10pm  — Rowan from ClearSky. Courier left a small cake and a box labeled 'samples' at the desk. Cake says 'do not refrigerate' lol. Any volunteer to escort and stash cake somewhere safe?
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x small cake (fragile), 1x sample box for Rowan. Placed in holding locker #6. Visitor badge preprinted.
Ethan: I can meet in lobby at 3:05 and escort. Where do we put cake?
Priya: Maybe put cake in the kitchen counter away from the AC vent. Label it with the name. Someone please confirm if it's gluten-free before sharing.
Maya (People Ops): Good call. @Front Desk please note allergy uncertainty. Also reserve Phone Booth 2 for 3:15-3:45 for a quiet chat.
Front Desk (Bot): Reservation created: Phone Booth 2 3:15-3:45. Note added: "Cake: allergy unknown, do not share without confirmation."
Liam: I'll meet Rowan at lobby and grab the cake info from the courier. Also will put Rowan (ClearSky) on whiteboard.
Ethan: Thanks Liam. I'll bring a spare charger and will escort guest upstairs.
Priya: Cake label says 'contains nuts'  so please do not share. Putting a sticky note on it now.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Priya. I'll text the host to let them know. Also parking: validation code P-CLSKY valid until 5pm.
Liam: Guest checked in, cake stored on kitchen counter with sticky note "DO NOT EAT - NUTS". Badge issued. All good.
Ethan: Guest escorted and in Phone Booth 2. Samples left in mailroom locker #6 for host.
Maya (People Ops): Amazing, thank you all! Quick follow-up: please log the sample box in Supplies sheet under "incoming vendor samples".
Priya: Done, logged with invoice number from courier.
Maya (People Ops): Closing thread  :party_popper:
